scope_note: Four original WiiWare Gecko plain-text code-bearing documents: GameCube controller (GC) and copy-filter sharp codes for source US Fluidity (WFLE) and European Hydroventure (WFLP). Preserve original code files and region IDs without fabricating six-character disc IDs.
rights_note: Archive retains quatric MIT LICENSE, full README and original Git SHA fingerprints. The source explicitly attributes the Classic Controller foundational Gecko hack to Vague Rant. The two Vague Rant Classic Controller-only code files are intentionally excluded; the imported GC bridges may still incorporate earlier controller logic and quatric's license alone does not establish independent rights for all prior contributors. The source states Gecko GC files are not covered by its Dolphin tests; hardware behavior unverified. Wii common-key binary and game/WAD assets are not archived.
